**impl — construction — holders**

**Impl:** exactly one concrete implementation, the unexported struct `service` in `internal/markdown/markdown.go` (declared at line 58), which satisfies the `markdown.Service` interface (lines 31–55: `ExtractAll`, `ExtractTags`, `ExtractProperties`, `RenderMarkdown`, `RenderHTML`, `GenerateSnippet`, `ValidateContent`, `RenameTag`). It wraps a `goldmark.Markdown` instance; there are no mocks, fakes, or alternate implementations anywhere in the repo. Internally, `RenderMarkdown` and `RenameTag` delegate to `renderer.NewMarkdownRenderer()` (`internal/markdown/renderer/markdown_renderer.go`), which is a plain concrete struct rather than another interface implementation.

**Construction:** the only production construction site is `NewAPIV1Service` in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go` (lines 47–62), which calls `markdown.NewService(markdown.WithTagExtension(), markdown.WithMentionExtension())` and stores the result in `APIV1Service.MarkdownService`. `NewService` (line 85) returns the `Service` interface, so the concrete type never escapes the package. `server/server.go` line 85 then hands that same instance to the RSS router: `rss.NewRSSService(s.Profile, s.Store, apiV1Service.MarkdownService)`, so one shared instance serves the whole process. Test setups construct their own: `server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go` line 44 (both extensions), `server/router/fileserver/fileserver_test.go` line 427 (tag extension only), and `server/router/rss/rss_test.go` line 54 (no options).

**Holders:** three structs hold the interface as a field. `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go` line 35) is used by `memo_service.go` (lines 108 and 447, passing it into `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload`), `memo_mention_helpers.go` line 32 (`ExtractAll`), and `memo_service_webhooks.go` line 85 (`GenerateSnippet`). `RSSService.MarkdownService` (`server/router/rss/rss.go` line 45) uses it at line 339 for server-side `RenderHTML` in feeds. `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` line 16) also declares the field, but note that `memopayload.NewRunner` is never called anywhere — `startBackgroundRunners` in `server/server.go` only starts the s3presign runner — so that holder is effectively dead code at runtime; the live path into that package is the free function `RebuildMemoPayload`, which takes `markdown.Service` as a parameter.

One clarification in case you meant the frontend: markdown in the web client also sits behind a separate TypeScript interface, `EditorController` in `web/src/components/MemoEditor/types/editorController.ts` (`getMarkdown`/`setMarkdown`/`insertMarkdown`). Its single implementation is built by `createController` in `web/src/components/MemoEditor/Editor/controller.ts`, called from `web/src/components/MemoEditor/Editor/index.tsx` line 61 and exposed via `useImperativeHandle`; holders are `MemoEditor` (`index.tsx` line 40 ref), `EditorContent`, `FormattingToolbar`, and the `useEditorActiveState`/`useMemoInit` hooks, all through refs rather than struct fields.
